summary: Completed testing of debt write-off (abandon) functionality. Fixed critical bug where Abandonner button was not visible for admin users due to incorrect auth store usage. All backend API tests pass (8/8). Frontend UI verified working correctly.

bugs_fixed.issue: Abandonner button not visible for admin users
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Page was using useAuthStore (Zustand with localStorage) which was never populated during login. The app uses AuthContext with IndexedDB for user data storage.
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed from 'useAuthStore' to 'useAuth' from AuthContext to correctly access user role

backend_api_tests: POST /api/debts/{debt_id}/write-off returns 404 for invalid debt ID
Admin can successfully write-off a debt with valid reason
Write-off creates payment history entry with type 'write_off'
Cannot write-off an already abandoned debt (400 error)
frontend_ui_tests: Abandonner button visible for admin users in Clients tab
Abandonner button NOT visible for cashier users (cashier doesn't have access to Debts page)
Write-off modal displays correctly with warning, client info, amount, and reason input
History tab shows write-off entries with red background (bg-red-50)
Write-off entries display negative amount in red with 'Passage en perte' label
Write-off reason is displayed in history

ui_components.abandonner_button: Visible only for admin users in Clients tab
ui_components.write_off_modal: Shows warning, client info, amount, reason input
ui_components.history_display: Red background, negative amount, 'Passage en perte' label

critical_code_review_comments: The app has two auth systems (AuthContext with IndexedDB and useAuthStore with localStorage) which can cause confusion. Consider consolidating to one system.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/Debts.js - Fixed auth store usage from useAuthStore to useAuth
/app/backend/tests/test_write_off.py - Created comprehensive test suite for write-off functionality
seed_data_creation: Used existing write-off entry (Hawa Sylla - 150000 GNF) from previous API test. Created additional write-off during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Write-off functionality fully tested and working. Key fix: Debts.js was using wrong auth store (useAuthStore instead of useAuth from AuthContext). The Abandonner button is now visible for admin users. History tab correctly displays write-off entries with red background and negative amounts. Backend API properly restricts write-off to admin users only.
mocked_api_note: No mocked APIs - all functionality is real
